phase: development; frozen before implementation and execution
scope: Finite acyclic membership graphs with overlap, exact retained history, explicit contextual boundaries, sequential nested workshop procedures and participant-owned primitive acquisition.

cases.criterion: Detailed and aggregate inventory projections and expanded versus nested procedure execution agree on protected material results and physical work; insufficient summaries cannot authorize physical execution.
Relevant child revisions invalidate every affected projection and no unrelated projection; internal invalidation leaves participant views unchanged; exact older projections reconstruct.
Joining needs an invitation and the joiner's paid acceptance; leaving or withdrawing permission preserves existing duties, ownership, completed work and history.
Shared capacity is retained only after all constituent work is performed and observed; a newcomer cannot perform or accept unacquired procedures; nested calls do not copy skill.
Partial work, cancellation, stale membership or consent, and overlapping resource contention preserve charges and prior effects without double spending; exact checkpoints continue correctly.

Raw transaction audit independently checks work, membership consent, collective decomposition, observations and capacity provenance; inherited U10 tests and witnesses and frozen baseline integrity pass.

work_contract.coordination: 1 + processed particular count + supplied graph/expansion visit budget + request syntax size, plus the inherited lawful Model A route
work_contract.physical: unchanged U4 prices, custody, ownership, reservations and acquired-use contracts
work_contract.machine_cost: measured separately; no U13 efficiency claim

limits: No membership cycles; finite self-representation uses ordinary references outside membership edges.
Invitations, group boundaries and candidate work programs are supplied operations, not emergent institutions.
The same coordinator manages linked subgroups in this first executable contract.
Collective programs bind exact worker, procedure and resource identities; they do not grant generalized individual competence.
A whole run is sequential and fails honestly after an observed constituent failure; completed effects are never rolled back.
The U14 reserved seeds and combinations are not used; U12-U14 and R21C release acceptance remain open.
